fields.mechanism: Multi-dimensional applicability index framework for evaluating regulatory alignment of international biomechanical standards
fields.intervention: Implement a multidimensional assessment protocol for limb prostesis design that evaluates clinical safety alignment, technical fit, contextual usability, documentation conformance, and regulatory interoperability
fields.expected_effect: Reduce adverse events by ensuring prosthetic devices are better aligned with actual use conditions and safety expectations across different jurisdictions
fields.falsification_test: Compare adverse event rates between prostheses designed using this multidimensional assessment protocol versus those designed using traditional methods
fields.mechanism_source_span: "This narrative review, combined with a conceptual framework and an illustrative cross-jurisdictional case study, proposes a multi-dimensional applicability index designed to evaluate the regulatory fit of international biomechanical standards before national adoption. The index comprises five dimensions clinical safety alignment, technical fit, contextual usability, documentation conformance, and regulatory interoperability, each providing a structured lens for assessing standard suitability."

fields.mechanism: Passive structural alignment of prosthetic testing standards with regulatory requirements
fields.intervention: Design limb prostheses with inherent structural features that inherently meet regulatory requirements without needing additional assessment protocols
fields.expected_effect: Devices that naturally align with regulatory expectations through their physical design, reducing the need for post-manufacturing evaluations and documentation
fields.falsification_test: Compare regulatory compliance documentation requirements for prostheses designed with inherent structural alignment versus those requiring additional assessment protocols
fields.mechanism_source_span: The index comprises five dimensions clinical safety alignment, technical fit, contextual usability, documentation conformance, and regulatory interoperability, each providing a structured lens for assessing standard suitability.

fields.falsification_test: Compare adverse event rates between prostheses designed using the multidimensional index assessment versus traditional design methods over a 2-year period
fields.mechanism_source_span: "This narrative review, combined with a conceptual framework and an illustrative cross-jurisdictional case study, proposes a multi-dimensional applicability index designed to evaluate the regulatory fit of international biomechanical standards before national adoption."

fields.mechanism: Hybrid biomechanical-thermal monitoring system with predictive analytics
fields.intervention: Integrate thermal sensors and biomechanical load sensors into the prosthesis structure, connected to an AI system that monitors for abnormal stress patterns and temperature changes
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of mechanical stress points and material degradation before they lead to device failure or adverse events
fields.falsification_test: Measure time-to-failure and failure modes between prostheses with the hybrid monitoring system versus conventional designs under simulated use conditions
